name: Goodberry
summary: Ten magic berries; eating one (Bonus Action) restores 1 Hit Point and feeds a creature for a day.
text: Ten magic berries appear in your hand and stay magical for 24 hours. A creature can take a Bonus Action to eat one berry, which restores 1 Hit Point and gives enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day. Any berries not eaten disappear when the spell ends.
